title: Changelog
note: The damage, speed, and other numbers shown here are the default values at the time of that release. Server-side config adjustments may mean the numbers you actually experience in-game are different.

groups.label: V1.1
groups.summary: Sounds come back after an audio device change

releases.title: Sounds come back after an audio device change
releases.summary: When the audio device changes (earphones plugged in or out, or a device chosen in the options), the game restarts its sound engine and drops every looping sound. In 1.1.0 to 1.1.3, Cherry's aircraft engines, afterburner, missile motors and lock tones, and the pressure suit's breathing, then stayed silent until you boarded again or put the helmet back on. They now start again by themselves.

sections.title: Highlights
items: After an audio device change, the Stratos-900 and Aegis-X engines, the Aegis-X afterburner, missile motors and the lock tones start again by themselves within a moment.
On the Moon, the pressure suit's breathing does the same.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

releases.title: Easy controls, and the railgun hits
releases.summary: Flying and sailing are rebuilt so that anyone can do it. The view is no longer locked: the aircraft fly where you look, and the ships answer to W, A, S and D like a boat. The Dreadnought's railgun now strikes what it hits; in 1.1.0 to 1.1.2 its shells damaged nothing.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Aircraft fly where you look: turn your head and the Stratos-900 or the Aegis-X banks, turns, climbs or dives towards it by herself. W and S set the throttle; left-click fires the Aegis-X's missiles at the target the radar picks by itself.
Flaps, landing gear, brakes, reverse thrust, the afterburner, the canopy and the arresting hook now work by themselves, and a short guide on the screen shows the controls when you board.
The view is yours: it no longer locks to first person or tilts with the aircraft, F5 works in flight, and holding Left Alt lets you look around while she keeps her course.

Ships: standing at a station shows the key that takes it. At the wheel, W and S drive the engine (astern below zero), A and D steer, and letting go centres the wheel and holds her heading; Sneak leaves. The ferry's doors are on Y.
With nobody at the gunnery console, the Dreadnought's helmsman fires the guns from the wheel: left-click for a salvo, right-click for the VLS.

Fixed from 1.1.2: the rudder turned the ship the opposite way to its keys, astern gave no thrust, a ship could not be launched from the shore (she now floats with her stern just past the water you aim at), and a ship could not be picked back up in survival.

The railgun's shells burst on the first block, creature, ship or aircraft in their path and damage what lies within 4 m; when a salvo lands on one target, all six shells count. Look at any part of a hull and both turrets train on that point.
The gun spares the ship that fired it and her crew, and it never breaks blocks. No ship or aircraft is sunk or brought down by a single salvo, and manning the guns no longer loads distant chunks.
A death message from one of Cherry's weapons no longer shows an untranslated key when the attacker holds a renamed item.

The Aegis-X's missile count at the bottom left of the flight display is no longer cut off by the bottom of the screen. With the automatic GUI scale this happened at many screen sizes, among them 720p, 1440p, 4K and the game's default window.
Chart waypoints are accepted only within the chart's widest view, about 1.4 km from the ship, which also protects servers from malformed waypoint requests.

sections.title: Warnings
items: The controls have changed: 1.1.2's flight keys (R, U, Y, K, Z, N, M, J and the arrow keys) and helm keys (, . = - ; ') are gone, and any of them you rebound are no longer used.
Railgun shells now hurt whatever they strike, including other players' ships and aircraft. The crew member directing the guns is credited with the damage.
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

releases.title: The ships, finished: real models, working stations and the ferry's doors
releases.summary: The Leviathan and the Dreadnought get their real models and interiors, and every station aboard now works from the game. In 1.1.0 and 1.1.1 the railgun, the VLS and the chart table could not actually be used; now they can.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Real ships: hulls, decks and interiors are fully modelled — the ferry's vehicle deck, lounge, observation deck and bridge, and the destroyer's bridge, CIC and hangar — with windows you can see through that light up at night. Every deck you see is a deck you can walk on.

Stations: stand at the wheel, the chart table, or the destroyer's gunnery or sonar station and press the station key (H by default) to take it. The chart table opens a chart you click to lay a route on; the new sonar station shows contacts on a sweeping scope.

The Dreadnought now carries two triple 406 mm railgun turrets. Both train on the point you look at and fire one salvo on a left click, with muzzle flashes, blast rings, tracers and recoiling barrels. A right click fires the VLS at the radar-locked target once its hatch is open, venting white smoke.

The Leviathan's bow visor and bow and stern ramps: stopped at the wheel, press the doors key (' by default). The visor rises before the ramp lowers, the engine stays locked until everything is shut again, and you can walk up the lowered ramps.
Wake and bubbles: a ship under way throws a bow wave at the Kelvin angle and leaves a wake behind her, and a turning screw churns bubbles.

The helm keys no longer clash with Minecraft's own keys: , and . turn the wheel, = and - set the engine, and ; holds the heading. The helm instruments now sit above the hotbar and health bar instead of on top of them.

sections.title: Warnings
items: The helm keys have new names, so a binding you changed for them in 1.1.0 or 1.1.1 is not carried over. Set it again.
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

releases.title: Fixed: the afterburner no longer crashes the game
releases.summary: With the video setting “Improved Transparency” turned on, lighting the Cherry Aegis-X’s afterburner crashed the game. It no longer does.

sections.title: Highlights
items: With “Improved Transparency” on, lighting the afterburner in flight (Z by default) no longer crashes the game, and its shock diamonds still show through the canopy from the cockpit.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

releases.title: The Aerospace & Naval Update — into the air and out to sea
releases.summary: Cherry gains aircraft, airports and ships. You can walk about on a flying aircraft or a ship under way.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Two aircraft: the Cherry Stratos-900 passenger and freight ferry and the Cherry Aegis-X stealth fighter, with a first-person cockpit, artificial horizon and reticle, retracting gear, flaps and afterburner.

Airport fittings: PAPI lights that change colour with your approach angle, a catapult to launch an aircraft, an arresting wire that catches a lowered tail hook, and a control radar that shows the aircraft around it.

Two ships: the 48 m Cherry Leviathan-Class ocean car ferry and the 64 m Cherry Dreadnought-Class guided missile destroyer. Put one on the water, take the wheel to steer, or lay a route at the chart table and she will sail it, keeping clear of shallows.

Only the Dreadnought-Class is armed: a 406 mm railgun turret that trains and elevates independently and rocks the hull when it fires, and a VLS that launches only once its hatch is fully open. The car ferry carries no armament.
Deck walking: run and jump about on a moving aircraft or ship. The deck under you carries you with it.
A ship goes back into your hand when she is stopped and nobody is on her deck. She remembers the damage she took, so putting her back on the water does not mend her.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

releases.title: Now on Minecraft 26.3
releases.summary: Cherry now runs on Minecraft 26.3. Everything from V1.0.0 comes along, and on a Moon you have already visited, newly generated ground meets the old.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Everything V1.0.0 added runs on Minecraft 26.3: the Moon, the Cherry Apex-1 and the Launch Pad Complex, the lunar rules, Overdrive Fusion, the lunar resources, Micrometeorites and both skills.
Worlds from V1.0.0 carry on: on the Moon, newly generated ground gets the same terrain and the same craters as V1.0.0, so it meets the ground you have already explored.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or later, Fabric API 0.161.0 or later, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or later, and Java 25.

releases.title: The Lunar Genesis Update — from the launch pad to the Moon
releases.summary: Cherry's first release: a separate mod brand that installs beside Alpha. Build the Launch Pad Complex, fly the Cherry Apex-1 to the Moon, and come home again.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Moon: a new dimension with craters, ore deposits and Helium-3 Geysers, and a clock of its own.
Cherry Apex-1 and the Launch Pad Complex: board the docked rocket, hold jump through the countdown, and fly from the Overworld to the Moon and back to the pad with the pilot aboard.
Lunar rules: gravity is one sixth, and the vacuum takes 15% of maximum health through any armour except the Pressure Suit. Inside a Pressure Field Projector's sphere you are safe.
Overdrive Fusion: in the Resonance Crucible, an overdriven weapon, tool or armour piece gets ×3 attack damage, armour, toughness or mining speed.
Lunar resources: the Ultrasonic Cutter extracts Regolith Core Deposits only while in resonance, and the Cryo Canister captures Helium-3 only while a geyser is erupting.
Micrometeorites strike the lunar surface and leave craters.
Two skills: Dimensional Cleave (300% damage along its cross only) and Astral Lift, flight with an overdriven chestplate.
Checked to start alongside all 13 Alpha 4.4.0 mods with no mixin conflicts.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or later, Fabric API 0.154.2 or later, GeckoLib 5.5.5 or later, and Java 25.
